title: End-of-Game Foul-to-Give Situation
description: Leading by a small margin late in the game with a foul to give, the defense practises using it wisely without fouling out of desperation.

content.objective: Use an available team foul wisely to disrupt the offense's rhythm without conceding free throws.
content.setup: A live defensive possession starts with the defense reminded they have one foul available to give before the other team shoots free throws.
instructions: The defense communicates clearly who has the green light to use the foul.
The chosen defender fouls early in the possession, well away from the basket, to use up clock without risk.
The rest of the defense plays normally, aware the foul has now been used.
Reset with a different simulated time and defender assigned to foul each rep.
coachingPoints: Communicate before the possession who will use the foul.
Foul early and away from the rim, never in a way that risks a shooting foul.
Stay disciplined for the rest of the possession once the foul is used.
commonMistakes: Fouling near the basket, risking free throws instead of just a non-shooting foul.
No clear communication, leading to confusion about who fouls.
Forgetting the backup option if the first read isn't there.
content.safety: The foul should be light and controlled, just enough to stop the clock legally and safely.
